convertibility_reason: Uses only built-in iCCI handles for TII calculation. Simple entry/exit rules with fixed lot sizing. No external .mqh libraries for trading logic. Standard market orders with fixed SL/TP.

derived_values.name: TII value from CCI-based calculation
derived_values.formula: 100 * (CCI_up - CCI_down) / (CCI_up + CCI_down) where CCI_up = sum of positive CCI deviations, CCI_down = sum of negative CCI deviations over period

derived_values.name: Signal Line
derived_values.formula: Simple Moving Average of TII values over InpMAPeriod

other_exits: Close long on short signal, close short on long signal

custom_logic_notes: TII is calculated internally using two CCI-based components: CCI_up (sum of close-to-close gains) and CCI_down (sum of close-to-close losses) over the TII period. The TII oscillates between 0 and 100; values above 50 indicate bullish intensity, below 50 indicate bearish intensity. The EA uses previous bar values (shift=1) for signal generation to avoid repainting. Digit adjustment applied: SL and TP values are multiplied by 10 when _Digits==5 or _Point<0.001.
python_conversion_notes: TII indicator must be reimplemented in Python using numpy: calculate CCI_up and CCI_down as sums of positive and negative close-to-close deviations over the period, then TII = 100 * (CCI_up - CCI_down) / (CCI_up + CCI_down). Signal line is a simple moving average of TII. Entry on crossover of TII above/below its signal line. SL/TP in pips with digit adjustment for 5-digit brokers. New bar guard is essential to prevent multiple entries per bar. Position check prevents stacking.
